text:
Rina: Quick heads-up — noticed a weird wording on the Deploy confirmation dialog when the model is quantized. Screenshot: https://img.redwood.example/xx/deploy-confirm.png :thinking:
Diego: I saw that too. The primary button says 'Deploy' but the body copy says 'This will convert your model to a lower-precision format and may change outputs.' We need clearer risk language and a fallback hint.
Priya: Agree. Current copy: 'Conversion may change responses.' Too vague. Suggest: 'Converting to low-precision (quantized) may alter generation quality for some prompts.'
Ava: Short and explicit is good. Also need an inline link to 'Learn more about quantization' that opens docs. For keyboard users the link must be tabbable inside the dialog.
Rina: Accessibility nit: the dialog's aria-labelledby references the header only; we should also provide aria-describedby for the explanatory paragraph and ensure the link has descriptive text, not 'click here'.
Diego: For the confirmation CTA label, should we use 'Confirm and Deploy' vs just 'Deploy'? Pros: 'Confirm and Deploy' makes the action explicit. Cons: longer button text causes layout shift.
Priya: I vote 'Deploy' but add a visually subtle prefix sentence: 'This action is permanent for this version. You can deploy a new variant later.' Keeps button short.
Ava: Also for localization, avoid idioms like 'this action is permanent'. Use 'This change cannot be undone for this model version.' Easier to translate.
Rina: Good call. Proposed final body copy: 'This change cannot be undone for this model version. Converting to low-precision (quantization) may affect output quality for some prompts. Learn more.' Link target: /docs/quantization#impact.
Diego: Tooltip microcopy related: in the model list there's an info tooltip that currently reads 'Quantized: saves cost'. That's dismissive. Suggest: 'Quantized — reduced precision to lower inference cost; may impact quality.' Keep it to one line if possible.
Priya: For small screens we should show shortened variant: 'Quantized — lower precision; may affect quality.' And include full sentence in sr-only element for screen readers.
Ava: Error message when conversion fails currently says 'Conversion failed, try again.' Needs to surface reason if available: e.g., 'Conversion failed: insufficient GPU memory. Try a smaller batch size or different instance type.' Use pattern: short visible message + hidden details toggle for engineers.
Rina: Yep add a 'Details' button that expands a pre element with the raw error for users with perms. That region should have role=region and aria-live=polite when it appears.
design-bot: Reminder — update i18n sheet (i18n/copy/deploy_dialog.csv) and flag strings needing longer context for translators (context: quantization impact).
Diego: Action items: Priya to write final copy variants (desktop/mobile/sr-only), Ava to prepare accessibility notes for devs, Rina to update Figma and link to docs, I'll add the error details pattern to the component spec.
Priya: Posting copy variants here shortly. Thanks! :raised_hands:
